title: 由斜杠划分区域
summary: 字符网格中的正斜杠和反斜杠把单位方格分割，求整个网格形成的区域数量。
insight: 把每格放大为 3×3 像素，斜杠用三个阻塞像素画出，问题转化为统计放大网格中空白连通分量。
pitfalls: 三倍分辨率足以阻断斜向穿越
正反斜杠的三个像素方向相反

solutions.title: 三倍网格洪泛
solutions.idea: 栅格化斜线后统计空白区域。
steps: 创建大小 3n 的 blocked 网格
字符 / 标记右上、中间、左下；字符码 92 的反斜杠标记左上、中间、右下
遍历所有未阻塞像素，每发现一个就区域数加一并 BFS 标记其四连通分量

code.java: class Solution { public int regionsBySlashes(String[] grid){int n=grid.length,size=3*n;boolean[][] blocked=new boolean[size][size];for(int r=0;r<n;r++)for(int c=0;c<n;c++){char ch=grid[r].charAt(c);if(ch=='/'){blocked[3*r][3*c+2]=blocked[3*r+1][3*c+1]=blocked[3*r+2][3*c]=true;}else if(ch==92){blocked[3*r][3*c]=blocked[3*r+1][3*c+1]=blocked[3*r+2][3*c+2]=true;}}int regions=0;int[][] directions={{1,0},{-1,0},{0,1},{0,-1}};for(int r=0;r<size;r++)for(int c=0;c<size;c++)if(!blocked[r][c]){regions++;Deque<int[]> queue=new ArrayDeque<>();queue.offer(new int[]{r,c});blocked[r][c]=true;while(!queue.isEmpty()){int[] cell=queue.poll();for(int[] d:directions){int nr=cell[0]+d[0],nc=cell[1]+d[1];if(nr>=0&&nr<size&&nc>=0&&nc<size&&!blocked[nr][nc]){blocked[nr][nc]=true;queue.offer(new int[]{nr,nc});}}}}return regions;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun regionsBySlashes(grid:Array<String>):Int{val n=grid.size;val size=3*n;val blocked=Array(size){BooleanArray(size)};for(r in 0 until n)for(c in 0 until n){val ch=grid[r][c];if(ch=='/'){blocked[3*r][3*c+2]=true;blocked[3*r+1][3*c+1]=true;blocked[3*r+2][3*c]=true}else if(ch.code==92){blocked[3*r][3*c]=true;blocked[3*r+1][3*c+1]=true;blocked[3*r+2][3*c+2]=true}};var regions=0;val directions=arrayOf(intArrayOf(1,0),intArrayOf(-1,0),intArrayOf(0,1),intArrayOf(0,-1));for(r in 0 until size)for(c in 0 until size)if(!blocked[r][c]){regions++;val queue=java.util.ArrayDeque<IntArray>();queue.addLast(intArrayOf(r,c));blocked[r][c]=true;while(queue.isNotEmpty()){val cell=queue.removeFirst();for(d in directions){val nr=cell[0]+d[0];val nc=cell[1]+d[1];if(nr in 0 until size&&nc in 0 until size&&!blocked[nr][nc]){blocked[nr][nc]=true;queue.addLast(intArrayOf(nr,nc))}}}};return regions} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int regionsBySlashes(vector<string>& grid){int n=grid.size(),size=3*n;vector<vector<bool>> blocked(size,vector<bool>(size));for(int r=0;r<n;++r)for(int c=0;c<n;++c){char ch=grid[r][c];if(ch=='/'){blocked[3*r][3*c+2]=blocked[3*r+1][3*c+1]=blocked[3*r+2][3*c]=true;}else if(ch==92){blocked[3*r][3*c]=blocked[3*r+1][3*c+1]=blocked[3*r+2][3*c+2]=true;}}int regions=0,directions[4][2]={{1,0},{-1,0},{0,1},{0,-1}};for(int r=0;r<size;++r)for(int c=0;c<size;++c)if(!blocked[r][c]){++regions;queue<pair<int,int>> pending;pending.push({r,c});blocked[r][c]=true;while(!pending.empty()){auto cell=pending.front();pending.pop();for(auto& d:directions){int nr=cell.first+d[0],nc=cell.second+d[1];if(nr>=0&&nr<size&&nc>=0&&nc<size&&!blocked[nr][nc]){blocked[nr][nc]=true;pending.push({nr,nc});}}}}return regions;} };
